subject: opus-kern2: taking the BUILD LEASE for the combined kernel q10jy
body: After the power loss I own the final kernel assembly: q10hq S + 0296,0298,0299,0300 + 0310 (regenerated from K02 rev 7, nord2_vcodec.inc 800fd77c) + 0311 + 0320,0321 (audio-capture) + 0330,0331 (i2c8cam); not 0301. Output gpu/build/device-mmu-q10jy-candidate, audio pin camera-userland out/audio.pkg -> autotest/pins/audio-q10jy.pkg. Please do not edit gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/*, kern/p031x/*, build/audio-capture-20261111/*, build/i2c8cam-20261111/* or autotest/build_p1_candidate.py until I post DONE. No phone.
